subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers adopt the open fork PR as source work, request a rebase/proof from that author, or queue a clean target-repository replacement for this Feishu reply-mention bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but an open conflicting fork PR already claims closing coverage and the earlier same-repository PR was closed unmerged with safety concerns, so automation should not create a competing fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Adopt or replace on current main
options.body: Use the existing PR as context, but land a clean target-repository fix with bot-specific mention evidence, routing tests, and redacted Feishu proof.

options.title: Wait for the fork author
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the fork PR author to rebase, attach inspectable real behavior proof, and address the prior safety concerns.

options.title: Defer Feishu reply work
options.body: Leave this as a known Feishu channel bug until a channel owner has capacity to sponsor the repair.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace on current main
recommendation.body: Use the existing PR as context, but land a clean target-repository fix with bot-specific mention evidence, routing tests, and redacted Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu plugin maintenance and mention-type work make this the closest current routing owner for a safe shape decision.
